profile.headline: Software Developer/Architect at Armstrong World Industries
profile.summary:
- 20 years of java career experience with Master's degree in Computer Science 
- Expert technical skills in Java development and Object-Oriented Analysis. Sun Certified Java Programmer (SCJP). 
- Strong database development experience with SQL servers in enhancing user access and GUI design. 

I am able to make an immediate positive impact for your company. I am looking for a Java Software Engineer or a Java Developer.

Specialties: XML, HTML, JSP, JavaScript, CSS, Java, J2EE, Oracle, MySQL, OpenGL, WYSIWYG layout tools

positions.title: Software Developer/Architect
positions.locationName: Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• 	Developed the functionality for ICE to export IFC files that load correctly in Revit. This required building and improving the IFC export workflow so that ICE’s 3D data could be accurately transferred and visualized in Revit.
• 	Developed IFC 2x3 format exporter from the 3D ICE platform, enabling accurate and reliable 3D visualization.
• 	Improved system interoperability by importing data from SketchUp into ICE for seamless integration.
• 	Resolved issues with broken 3D visualization in ICE’s outdated version, delivering correct and stable outputs.
• 	Enhanced model realism by adding glass texturing in Revit, improving visualization quality for end users.
• 	Strengthened overall system performance through debugging and technical problem‑solving across visualization workflows
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Core Java · SQL Database · Git · Maven · Revit · Unity · Xith3D · .NET Framework · JUnit

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Develop application in Java and JOGL for bio-informatics. Analyzed application prototype  and collaborate with professor to create functionality specs and user interface. 
- Use profecient Java IO performance to read huge bio data (7M), enhancing GUI design.

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed the DB schemas for the MCP (Master Control Processor) Project - Nice Replacement System for Old and User Un-friendly Cleanroom Transport System.
- Efforted software engineering skills for Cleanroom Transport Screen application using Java and XML, creating XML contained its positions and functionalities, importing XML with DOM API, and storing persitent DB(MySQL/Oracle). 
- Performed requirements analysis, design, development, implementation, testing, and maintenance. 
- Implemented application GUI to use the previous layer sources and created new functional interfaces and modified exiting programs using Java Swing, AWT, and Java 2D. 
- Developed J2EE application with JNDI, JMS and JBoss using JBuilder.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Drug Design and Molecular Design components for CSE-Online, an infrastructure for High Performance Computational Science and Engineering

- Analyzed application prototypes and suggested solutions. 
- Developed applications in Java, J2EE for Chemistry educational purposes. Collaborated with colleagues to achieve indepent application tasks. 
- Used Java Swing to develope the BioDesign application for knowledge based structure and bio-sequent data, drawing node structure and displaying table model. Added Python scriptions and imported XML  with SAX API.
- Modified and upgraded existing 2D plot program with new features (bar and chart). 
- Built the CSEO Web Forum Website, including registration and manigering users. Used JDBC Pool , PostgreSQL database  Tomcat server, and JSP. Localized open source.

positions.title: Human Resource Application Programmer
positions.description:
- Co-developed payroll check and taxes T-SQL programs. Created electronic forms for an intra-Net mail system. 
- Used PowerBuilder  to create and utilize several documents sourced on HR DB. Converted paper print documents into electronic forms.
- Designed the tables of MS Access for HR training DB and migrated them into the Sybase RDBM.

HR Manager/ Personnel Manager Assistant/ GeneralAssociate                                          Feb 1994 ~ Jul 2001
- Trained and Recruited for IT employees. Computed yearly, quarterly, and monthly benefits and payroll totals. Assisted general works.
